title: Vision-language foundation model for echocardiogram interpretation.
summary: The primary study trains EchoCLIP on over one million echocardiogram/text pairs and reports internal and external clinical interpretation results, including cardiac-function and device identification; it is validation evidence, not proof of clinical benefit.
